panels.title: State-Space Phase Portrait: Error vs. ΔError/Δt

targets.query:
from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "error")
  |> derivative(unit: 50ms, nonNegative: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "error_derivative")
  |> yield(name: "derivative")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "error")
  |> yield(name: "error")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "rtt_ms")
  |> group()
  |> yield(name: "rtt_dist")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "control_signal")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "actuator_heatmap")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "error")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value < 0.0 then -r._value else r._value }))
  |> group(columns: ["algorithm", "trial_id"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r._value,
      _field: r.algorithm + " (" + r.trial_id + ")"
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "iae")

from(bucket: "wireless_pid_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "control_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "is_loss")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: r._time,
      _value: r._value,
      _field: "Link: " + r.trial_id
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> yield(name: "link_state")
